description: Collects extra positional arguments into a tuple.
Collects extra keyword arguments into a new dict, in call order.
`f(*items, **mapping)` spreads an iterable into positional arguments and a mapping into keyword arguments.
Passing the arguments a wrapper received to another callable unchanged: `function(*args, **kwargs)`.
A keyword-only parameter after `*args` (like `attempts`) that the wrapper consumes and never forwards.
